name: cannon-items
description: The Hand Cannon items in the game are the approved ones (D-051 addendum 2, D-053): the cannon is 20 Iron + 5 Wood + 5 Resin at a Forge level 2 and never stacks, the Cannon Ball (2 Iron at a Forge level 2) never stacks, the Cannon Stock is a build piece in the hammer's KY-Items category of 10 Wood + 4 Resin at a Workbench; all three are listed in KydlCore's KY-Items registry

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: forge level 2, makes 1, enabled True: Iron x20, Wood x5, Resin x5
steps.label: the cannon recipe in the game

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: forge level 2, makes 1, enabled True: Iron x2
steps.label: the cannon ball recipe in the game

steps.name: GunPowdered.pieceOf
steps.expect: category KY-Items, station piece_workbench, enabled True: Wood x10, Resin x4, in KY-Items True
steps.label: the cannon stock is in the KY-Items build category and listed in KY-Items

steps.name: GunPowdered.kyItemsListed
steps.label: every item and piece of the mod is in the KY-Items list
